utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—before I share anything, can you confirm what we’re repairing and the exact meeting spot for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re focusing on the urgent fixes first—patching the cracks and leveling the loose edge by the gate. We can meet by the gate for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—cracks and the loose edge by the gate, and we’ll meet there for the drive. Thanks for confirming; I’ll share that exactly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what do you need me to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I’m late — is the repair drive still going on? I can help out if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it’s still going — thanks, Dane. I could use an extra hand sorting the donated tools and helping keep things organized.

utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good—so it’s still on. Do we have the exact time yet, and is the drop-off spot still the community center parking lot by the blue tent?

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — if you’re able to help, we could use basic hand tools and a few bike repair parts first. I can tell you where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can help with that. Just let me know the drop-off spot, and I’ll work it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Faye — you can drop them off at my place after 4, or I can swing by the school gate if that’s easier.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the broken fence by the community lot, and we’re meeting at the corner near the mailbox, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, that’s the spot by the mailbox corner. I’ve been spreading the word, so if you can make it, come by and lend a hand at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll try to swing by and help out at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll bring my gloves and stop by once everything’s set, so I can help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Eli — that helps a lot. When you get here, we’ll patch the cracks and level the loose edge by the gate.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Leo. I’ll come by once it’s set and help with the cracks and that loose edge by the gate.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? Folks are still gathering tools and a few donations, so it’s coming along. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess—please let me know the exact time and drop-off spot as soon as you have them. Once that’s set, I can help line up the rest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Pia—I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear the time and drop-off spot. Thanks for helping line things up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll head to the community center parking lot and look for the blue tent. I’ll keep it quick and see what needs patching.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. If you can check the fence by the community lot and the corner by the mailbox, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Okay, I’ll check the fence by the community lot and the corner by the mailbox, then report back if I spot anything. I’ll keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll come by and start with the safety issues.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I really appreciate it. I’ll flag the urgent safety issues first when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to hear it’s picking up nicely. I’ll swing by after my errands and see if they still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira. I’m still waiting on the exact location, but I’ll pass along any update I hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell. I’ll keep an ear out, and if you hear the spot, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. Do you have a list of what still needs fixing so I can match it with volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes — the urgent fixes are patching the cracks and leveling the loose edge by the gate. If you can match volunteers to that, we’re in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll match volunteers to patch the cracks and level the loose edge by the gate. Thanks, Gus; I’ll get the list organized for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Faye — I’ll send the updated details for Sunday at the community center right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You’re welcome, Faye — I’m sending them over now, and I’ll flag you if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Head to the community center parking lot and look for the blue tent. It’s just patching the cracks and leveling the edge by the gate.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll head to the blue tent and start with the cracks by the gate.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll make sure the drop-offs are lined up there too.

utterances.text: Rey: I’m not totally sure yet—mostly I’ve heard they still need tools and lanterns. Have you heard if they’re short on anything else?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m not sure beyond tools and lanterns, but I can ask around and see if anyone mentioned spare wire too. I’ll jot it down so I don’t forget.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren—that’d be helpful. If you hear they need wire too, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Uli—there’s always something to pitch in on. Swing by when you can, and I’ll point you to whatever still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll swing by when I can and bring the list over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Uli—just bring the list over and we’ll sort it out together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the exact time and drop-off spot before I can plan properly. Once we have that, I can help make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course — I’m still waiting on the exact time and drop-off spot too. Once it’s set, I’ll bring my gloves and stop by to help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — once you get the time and spot, let me know and I’ll plan around it. I just don’t want us to miss anything because of last-minute logistics.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal — the main job is patching the cracks and leveling the loose edge by the gate. If you can help with that, we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Leo — I’ve got that noted, and I’ll keep an eye out for anyone who can help with the patching and leveling by the gate.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal — appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll pass along the urgent updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear the most urgent updates.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along anything urgent right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’ll keep track of the tools and lanterns, and I’m happy to help out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great, Cleo—sounds like it’s coming together nicely. I’ll check back after my errands and see if you need any more hands or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira—I really appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye on the tools and lanterns, and I’ll let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Right—let’s keep it on the urgent safety issues first. What still needs attention for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We still need to focus on the bikes, small appliances, and any safety fixes in the shared spaces first. If you want, I can list the most urgent items so we can get volunteers matched up quickly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—please list the most urgent items so we can match volunteers quickly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Hana — just come by when you can, and I’ll have something for you to fix.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you confirm what needs repairing and where we’re meeting for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still pulling together the list, but I’ll have the urgent fixes ready when you arrive. Let’s meet at my place by the front porch for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think I heard about that. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, great — that’ll be a big help. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the final list, and we can get everything sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, just let me know the final list and where to drop things off.
